chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali Majiluyah (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Abu Sa'id al-Adamy, from Ibrahim ibn Dawud al-Yaqoobi, from his brother Suleiman ibn Dawud, linking it up through his chain of narrators to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), who said:

A man said to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family): 'O Messenger of God! Teach me something that if I do it, God will love me from the heavens and the people will love me from the earth.' He said to him: 'Be inclined to what is with God, the Mighty and Exalted, and God will love you; and be detached from what is with the people, and the people will love you.'

key_terms.رَغْبَة: Inclination or strong desire for something
key_terms.زَهْد: Detachment or asceticism from worldly matters
key_terms.عِندَ النَّاسِ: What is with the people (worldly goods/status)

ai.seo_question: What is the key to gaining both God's love and people's love according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Al-Khisal*, the Prophet (peace be upon him) outlines a dual spiritual mechanism where internal orientation (*raghba*) toward the Divine secures God’s love, while external detachment (*zuhd*) from creation fosters human affection. This teaching reflects the Shia emphasis on balancing inner devotion with social humility, illustrating how spiritual asceticism naturally translates into social charisma and divine favor.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 2-84 Muhammad ibn Ali Majiluyih - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar quoted Muhammad ibn Ahmad, on the authority of Abi Sa’id al-Adamy, on the authority of Ibrahim ibn Davood al-Yaqoobi, on the authority of his brother Suleiman ibn Davood who linked it up through a chain of narrators to God’s Prophet (MGB) and said, “A man told the Prophet (MGB), ‘O Prophet of God! Please let me know of something which I do and be loved by God in the heavens and by the people on the Earth.’
The Prophet (MGB) told him, ‘Be inclined to what is near the Honorable the Exalted God to be loved by God, and abstain from what is near the people to be loved by the people.’”
